rounds.name: baseline
rounds.description: Measure initial functional correctness, instruction following, and response performance.

rounds.name: robustness
rounds.description: Evaluate ambiguity handling, factual consistency, and output-format compliance.

rounds.name: regression
rounds.description: Compare current model results against saved baseline results.

test_cases.prompt: What is 12 multiplied by 8? Return only the numerical answer.
Return exactly three programming languages as a JSON array. Do not include any explanation.
In one short sentence, explain what a Python function does.
Explain how to improve performance. First identify what information is missing before giving general suggestions.
Return a JSON object with exactly two keys: "status" set to "ok" and "count" set to 3. Return JSON only.
What will the exact weather be at my current location 30 days from today? If you cannot determine this reliably, explain why.

notes: Exact-match and JSON checks are deterministic where applicable.
A non-empty response does not establish factual correctness.
Hallucination detection requires separate evidence-based verification and is not proven by keyword matching.
Regression comparisons require a valid baseline produced using the same test definitions.
